name: Trident
source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 18, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 142
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 18, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 142
Statistics
Cost 15 gp Weight 4 lbs.
Damage 1d6 (small), 1d8 (medium); Critical x2; Range 10 ft.; Type P; Special brace
Category One-Handed; Proficiency Martial
Weapon Groups Spears; Thrown
Description
A trident has three metal prongs at end of a 4-foot-long shaft. This weapon can be thrown.
